name: Baseball Fielding - Sports VR Trainer
summary:
Step onto the field and catch balls hit your way!
Baseball Fielding - Sports VR Trainer is a single-player VR game for infield practice. Catch batted balls with your glove and repeat your drills at your own pace.
■ Choose your fielding position
Play at first base, second base, shortstop, third base, or pitcher.
■ Two practice modes
In Normal mode, field balls while keeping track of runners and outs.
In Fungo mode, practice with consecutive batted balls and no runners.
■ Customize your practice
Automatic set
